eventName: World Environment Giant tree Plantation Ceremony
eventDescription:
On the occasion of World Environment Day, the Kanchipuram District Education Department, Seeds Volunteer Organization, Mamallan Hospital and Triveni Academy jointly organized a sapling planting ceremony at the Bash Community Forest Center with the aim of increasing green spaces.

The Kanchipuram District Principal Education Officer Mrs. Vetriselvi participated as the special guest and inaugurated the sapling planting ceremony.

At this ceremony, 250 Tamil trees of natural richness such as Azhinjil, Purasai, Iluppai, Ilavam Panchu Koduktapuli, Nettilingam, Thanri Maram, Punnai, Kadambu and Thethangkottai were planted.

With the beauty of nature being destroyed day by day, it has become a necessity of this era to instill awareness about environmental protection in the minds of children and youth.
